issues.claim_quote: Across the whole packet, policy debate follows one dominant pattern shown by the cited source.

evidence.quote: We are dealing with the mess of the uncontrolled immigration system that was left by the previous Labour Government; this Government are getting to grips with our immigration system, unlike the Labour party.

issues.mechanism: The evidence focuses on specific government policies and criticisms of previous governments, lacking a broader, overarching pattern across 'the whole packet' of policy debate.
issues.material_consequence: The claim creates a misleading impression of a unified, dominant pattern when the cited excerpts present a fragmented discussion of immigration policies and their historical context.
issues.counterconditions: No counterconditions are provided to challenge this contextual flattening.

review.rationale: The evidence demonstrates a narrow focus on immigration policy, failing to establish a dominant, overarching pattern across all policy debate as the claim asserts.
